graphql.query:
mutation ($orgId: Int!, $orgHandler: String!, $projectId: String!) {
  createIntegrationComponent(
    component: {
      name: "mi-service"
      displayName: "mi-service"
      description: ""
      orgId: $orgId
      orgHandler: $orgHandler
      projectId: $projectId
      labels: ""
      componentType: "miApiService"
      accessibility: "external"
      srcGitRepoUrl: "https://github.com/chameerar/hello-world-project"
      srcGitRepoBranch: "main"
      repositorySubPath: ""
      oasFilePath: ""
      version: "1.0.0"
      secretRef: ""
    }
  ) {
    id
    organizationId
    projectId
    handle
  }
}

graphql.query:
query ($projectId: String!, $componentHandler: String!) {
  component(projectId: $projectId, componentHandler: $componentHandler) {
    id
    name
    handler
    description
    displayType
    displayName
    ownerName
    orgId
    orgHandler
    version
    labels
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    projectId
    apiId
    httpBased
    isMigrationCompleted
    repository {
      gitProvider
      nameApp
      nameConfig
      branch
      branchApp
      organizationApp
      organizationConfig
      isUserManage
      appSubPath
      byocBuildConfig {
        id
        isMainContainer
        containerId
        componentId
        repositoryId
        dockerContext
        dockerfilePath
        oasFilePath
      }
      byocWebAppBuildConfig {
        id
        containerId
        componentId
        repositoryId
        dockerContext
        webAppType
        buildCommand
        packageManagerVersion
        outputDirectory
      }
    }
    apiVersions {
      apiVersion
      proxyName
      proxyUrl
      proxyId
      id
      state
      latest
      branch
      accessibility
      appEnvVersions {
        environmentId
        releaseId
        release {
          id
          metadata {
            choreoEnv
          }
          environmentId
          environment
          gitHash
          gitOpsHash
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
